## User problem

Who encounters this problem, in which experience, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the behavior and a concrete example. State whether this is a local feature, scripted demonstration or a proposal requiring real cloud/device integration.

## Alternatives and boundaries

Describe the current workaround and any permissions, confirmation, data-retention or simulation constraints that matter.

## How to verify

What observable result would show that the problem is solved? Use fictional data and do not include credentials or household information.
